name: A Lista
summary: Alice, Micaela, Bruno, Sérgio and Paulo get together, ten days after Patricia's unexpected death. Together, they open the bottle of origamis to fulfill her dreams, among which there are bizarre and illegal requests.

name: Österreich - Die ganze Geschichte
summary: In a high-quality and comprehensive presentation, ORF III narrates the history of our country from its very beginnings.

name: FOX Business Live
summary: FOX Business LIVE at 12 PM, delivers real-time breaking news, market updates, and expert analysis. Featuring exclusive interviews with top industry leaders, it provides viewers with critical insights to stay informed and ahead on issues that affect their wallet .

name: Madrid with Michael Portillo
summary: Michael takes us to one of his favourite European cities - the Spanish capital Madrid.

name: Navires de légende
summary: Tracing the history of legendary ships that bear witness to the advances in engineering in the 20th century, this innovative series immerses us in the heart of great naval battles. With unpublished archive images and 3D models of realistic photos in 4K.

name: The Dirty A
summary: Artists signed to Atlanta's hottest record label, the Dirty A, navigate shady record deals, greed, and jealousy while trying to live their best lives.

name: Death of the Party
summary: Death of the Party takes a look at mysterious murder stories linked to house parties, banquets, concerts, festivals, or events. There's no environment like a party to create the perfect recipe for cold blooded murder. Each episode looks beyond the party favors and celebratory atmosphere to get to the bottom of the mysterious death that occurred. Did someone have a motive? Was it an accident? Or was it being in the wrong place at the wrong time? Detectives have their work cut out for them as they piece together the events of the evening from inaccurate witness accounts, cagey party goers, and a chaotic crime scene.

name: Swipe Left or Death
summary: Discover the chilling stories of ordinary people who fell victim to the dangers of online dating apps and suffered deadly consequences.

name: The Lesbian Homie
summary: After finally getting over his toxic relationship with a gay woman who broke his heart, Bruce finds himself in another pickle with a new partner.

name: Murdered in Paradise
summary: Idyllic vacations turn deadly, unraveling mysteries of betrayal, deceit, and gruesome murder.

name: House of Heat
summary: Adult content creators move into a house to help grow each other's fanbase on OnlyFans, TikTok & Instagram. In this house, they better bring the heat!

name: The Lake Winnipeg Project
summary: The Lake Winnipeg Project is a documentary that calls attention to stories of ingenuity and resilience among the Anishinaabe, Cree, and Métis communities of Matheson Island, Poplar River First Nation, Fisher River Cree Nation, and Camp Morningstar, at a time when many external forces are imposing change. Highlights their responses to various challenges and factors such as a shifting climate, industrial encroachment, government policy, and the COVID-19 pandemic, among others. Anishinaabe/Cree director Kevin Settee takes an "own-voices" approach to storytelling that gives Lake Winnipeg communities and peoples the opportunity to tell their own stories, in their own voices, and to speak to the challenges and successes experienced within their communities.

name: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero
summary:
This January, join acclaimed Torres Strait Islander chef and cultural ambassador Nornie Bero on a vibrant journey through the breathtaking landscapes and rich traditions of her homeland in her brand-new series, Island Echoes with Nornie Bero. Nornie explores the unique stories, flavours and histories of the Torres Strait Islands, showcasing the diverse cultures that thrive in this remote paradise.

Known for her passion for Indigenous cuisine and storytelling, Nornie invites viewers into her world as she cooks traditional dishes using locally sourced ingredients, while also sharing the customs of her Ancestors. From fishing with local communities to participating in traditional ceremonies, Nornie connects the past with the present, highlighting the resilience and creativity of the Torres Strait people.

Island Echoes with Nornie Bero is not just a cooking show; it's a celebration of culture, community, and connection to the land. Each episode includes a feast, where Nornie and her guests reflect on the importance of heritage, sustainability, and the power of food to bring people together.

In the series, Nornie returns to her roots on Mer Island, a place steeped in cultural significance and personal memories, where she reflects on her journey as a chef and cultural advocate while reconnecting with the vibrant community that shaped her.

Throughout the journey, discover traditions that have been passed down through generations and explore many incredible locations and recipes of the Torres Strait including island scallops with ocean seasoning in Badu Island, musu steak with wattle seed in Moa and a delicious fresh Masig seafood platter in Masig.

In Island Echoes, discover the echoes of the past that resonate through the vibrant culture of the Torres Strait Islands and be inspired to cherish and celebrate the stories that shape our world.

previousepisode.name: Kup Murri and the Spirit of Tradition

name: Long Story Short
summary: Long Story Short is an animated comedy about a family over time. It's about the shared history, the inside jokes, the old wounds. If you've ever had a mother, father, sibling, partner, or child, this is the show for you — and by the way, would it kill you to call them?

name: Beatrix
summary: Documentary miniseries about the former Queen of the Netherlands, Beatrix.

name: The Clinic for Well People
summary: People who are not considered to be sick and have no underlying illnesses visit the clinic and undertake an extensive health scan. Hours later they will find out if they truly are well, or if something has been found that requires further investigation, starting with their GP.

name: The Last Party: Death on Tresco
summary: 23-year-old Josh Clayton mysteriously disappeared off one of Britain's private islands. He was last seen at a party hosted by a member of the aristocratic Dorrien-Smith family. Now, Josh's family must explore the dark rumours surrounding his death.

name: Safe Harbor
summary: Genius hacker Tobias and his best friend Marco are determined to become the tech billionaires of the future. When they come on the radar of the Irish mafia, the notorious Walsh family, they are inadvertently dragged into the dangerous and cutthroat world of European drug trafficking.

name: Украденная красота
summary: 20-year-old Elena, rushing to a date with handsome Igor, goes down into an underground passage and comes out 30 years older. Trying to understand what happened to her, Elena learns about a magic medallion that grants youth to its owner, taking it from others. Now the heroine will have to not only get her beauty back, but also understand that you have to fight for your happiness at any age.

name: Дублёр
summary: The infamous football player Anton Korolev swaps bodies with a simple courier after an accident with a falling elevator. Anton's body is in a coma, and now he has to live someone else's and very earthly life, where there is no more fame and money, but there is someone else's wife and children to take care of. In addition, watching what is happening from the outside, Korolev sees the real motives of his past environment, which makes him look at the world differently.

name: Другая жизнь
summary: Student Polina, having decided that the most important thing in life is still love, refuses an internship abroad and marries the guy of her dreams. 15 years pass, now she is a housewife with three children, tired of everyday and everyday problems. In her heart, Polina says: "I want everything to be different!" And wakes up in an alternative reality, where she, having once chosen a career, became successful and wealthy, but did not acquire a strong relationship. Meanwhile, Polina the careerist ends up in the family of Polina the housewife, to her children, because she was also dissatisfied with her life and wished for a new one. In order to return back, both women will have to reconsider their life principles in search of harmony.

name: Loremasters
summary: Loremasters is the official Warhammer lore show, presented by experts. Each episode dives into the rich worlds of Warhammer and lifts the lid on the iconic characters, locations, and events that have defined Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar from the beginning.

name: Impression of Youth
summary: Art graduate student Yu Xing is forced by his professor to spend a month teaching at a rural high school as a substitute teacher in the hopes that the change of scenery will inspire Yu Xing and help him salvage his rejected graduation project. Upon his arrival, Yu Xing meets Xu Lu Hui, a cheerful high school student with a passion for painting but limited opportunities to pursue it. While their initial interactions aren't the smoothest, the two eventually strike up a deal together: if Lu Hui drives Yu Xing to outdoor sketch locations, Yu Xing will give Lu Hui private art lessons outside school hours. As they spend more time together and their bond deepens, Lu Hui begins to develop feelings for his substitute teacher. What will become of this forbidden romance?

name: The Korean War: Fire and Ice
summary: The Korean War: Fire and Ice is a 1999 documentary that provides a comprehensive look at the Korean War. It includes wartime footage, voice-over, and on-camera commentary from veterans and military historians. The documentary covers key events and battles from the conflict and highlights the experiences of those who lived through the war.

name: Shaw And Partners Iron Series
summary: Live coverage of the Australian surfing competition.

name: Mini Oiii
summary: Here there is room to investigate and be part of what happens when curious children encounter funny, cute and exciting animals. For our youngest viewers.

name: Grundy
summary: For newsagent Grundy, the need to keep a constant vigil against the permissive society lies heavy on the wreckage of his marriage.

previousepisode.name: What You Don't See, Ask For

name: Liberation: D-Day to Berlin
summary: Experience the liberation of Western Europe from every angle, as astonishingly colorized and expertly restored footage bring the historic turning point of World War II back to vivid life.

name: Spies In The Outback
summary: Dive into the murky world of spies, lies and secrets surrounding the most secretive place in Australia. Pine Gap has been called a space base, a spy base, an obscenity hidden on the fringe of an outback Australian town.

name: VK ПОД ШУБОЙ
summary: New Year's show from the VKontakte company. Unusual interpretation of famous songs and unimaginable duets and collaborations.

name: Romance Policial: Espinosa
summary: Detective Espinosa forms a task force when police officers in his precinct are murdered under similar circumstances. But as the investigation progresses, he suspects corruption within the force, becoming the hunted instead of the hunter.

name: Spooksoeker
summary: When he is suddenly thrust into the supernatural realm, a teenage boy must quickly learn how to banish ghosts and save his town, friends, and family.

name: Hameln
summary: Return of the Pied Piper In the Middle Ages he kidnapped 130 children. Now the Pied Piper of Hamelin is returning with them after almost eight centuries. Only a blind woman, a deaf man and a person with a walking disability can stop him. In present-day Hamelin, the blind Finja meets the deaf Jannik, who claims to have seen Finja and Ruben, a boy with a walking disability, in his dreams. The young people Finja, Jannik and Ruben witness mysterious events that seem to have something to do with the Pied Piper of Hamelin. Is the legend just an old myth or will the three soon have to fear for their own lives?

name: Jürgen
summary: The Anfield Wrap travelled to Glatten, Frankfurt, Mainz, Dortmund and around Liverpool to hear unique stories from the German's journey, told by those who know him best. The five part docu-series explores five recurring themes throughout Jürgen's story — challenge, Blueprint, journey, winning and legacy — and features footballers that played with and under him, friends that stood by his side through thick and thin, colleagues that helped him move to the next level and the fans that gave him their undying support throughout.

name: ВКАТИТ
summary: The host of the show SHENA invites guests to talk about how music influences their lives — and listen to demos of up-and-coming artists. With the help of a mind tracker, we track sincere reactions and choose with our hearts those tracks that will be officially released and will appear on the VK Music showcase at the end of the season.

name: The Relic Keeper
summary: Xiaoyue, a museum exhibit administrator, meets the maid Yaoyao and constable Mr. Qin from the Western Han Dynasty due to an accident. Yaoyao and Wang Xiao, Xiaoyue's mother, are swapped due to mysterious forces. Wang Xiao is taken back to the Western Han Dynasty while Yaoyao stays in the modern world. Xiaoyue and Yaoyao strive to find a way to travel through time and finally uncover the secrets of Lady Xin Zhui and Li Xi.

name: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives
summary: Six filmmakers adapt classic movies through a contemporary lens, tackling modern-day issues surrounding identity.

name: Snow Crew
summary: Set in the country's top ski resort follows a young, charismatic crew across the winter 2022 as they manage 6,000 people on each mountain each day of the season

name: Made in France
summary: It's a crisis! Rita, 50, discovers that her husband, Olivier, has cheated on her. But Rita and Olivier have been together for thirty years, with four children, and when she's not looking after them, Rita helps Olivier by doing the accounting for his garage-body shop. But who is this "other" woman? Olympe, 38, a senior executive at Valières, a major French luxury leather goods brand, is the opposite of Rita. A powerful woman, she comes from a very privileged background. A workaholic and ambitious, she's chic, beautiful, and has a CV as long as your arm. Rita decides to confront her and goes to the Valières headquarters. But nothing goes as planned. And while Rita has every reason to hate Olympe, and Olympe to distrust Rita, Rita will on the contrary, even though she knows nothing about the world of luxury,... become Olympe's assistant! Forced to work together, how long can such a duo last?

name: Lucy Investigates
summary: Lucy Kennedy is taken out of her comfort zone as she immerses herself in four unique lifestyle groups in Ireland, that reflect the lives of young Irish people, as she sets out to ask some deeper questions about these parts of Irish society that rarely get time in the spotlight.

name: The Traitors
summary: The Traitors puts 20 contestants in a royal palace to compete for a cash prize through physical and psychological challenges. Some players are secretly designated as "traitors" who must eliminate the "innocents" without being discovered.

name: Hbugdim
summary: Israeli edition of the iconic global reality TV phenomenon "The Traitors".

name: Heart Beat
summary: RK Multispeciality Hospital is a beacon of hope and healing. Its doctors are resilient even when they have to deal with medical and personal challenges.

name: Jumping the Queue
summary: A middle-class woman contemplating suicide becomes involved with a suspected killer on the run.

name: DESIGN MUSEUM JAPAN
summary: Japanese design is world famous, but that's not because of expensive, stylish or modern products. It's because excellent design exists within the tools and habits of everyday life. In this 10-part series, leading creators visit different parts of the country to hear these unfamiliar stories, revealing rich and complex insights.

name: Deeper Look
summary: A cutting-edge interview program from NHK WORLD-JAPAN's production team in New York. Covers the hot issue: from politics, economy, social matters, international situation or cultural topics.

previousepisode.name: Bridging Beyond Fandom, Japan Society's Evolving Role: Joshua Walker, President & CEO Japan Society

name: Japan Delish
summary: Japan Delish is a banquet of foods from overseas adopted by the Japanese. From fare steeped in tradition to its many modern variations, uncover the delicious histories at the heart of every dish.

name: MATSURI: The Heartbeat of Japan
summary: Traditional festivals called matsuri are found all over Japan. In this series, we present diverse matsuri and the preparations leading up to them. Each matsuri presents a new face of local Japan.

name: MICE MEDIA: Lessons in Internet Literacy
summary: A family of mice navigate the treacherous world of online information in MICE MEDIA: Lessons in Internet Literacy. The father can't help but believe information he finds on his smartphone, and each time, his daughter must step in and teach him about the traps of the internet and social media. This five-minute educational comedy helps viewers learn the essentials of internet literacy through a quirky and lovable father-daughter duo.

previousepisode.name: Beware! False info and Impression Farming

name: Ninja Truth
summary: Ninja are now seen in popular media around the world. But as their profile rises, their reality gets muddied amid legends and fantasies. The truth about authentic ninja lies unknown, shrouded in mystery. This program carefully examines the fighting skills and tools used by actual ninja, and conducts experiments to determine the "Ninja Truth".

name: My Street Piano
summary: Pianos are placed in airports, stations and on street corners around the world for anyone to play. Join us in unraveling the life stories of performers through the eyes of fixed cameras.

name: Origami Magic
summary: Do you know what "origami" is? It is a magic made from a single sheet of paper. This program showcases the creations of artists from around the globe inspired by the Japanese traditional craft.

previousepisode.name: The Magical World of Paper Figures

name: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE
summary: Centuries ago, Tokyo was known as Edo. More than a million people enjoyed life in this small but abundant city. They live on in ukiyo-e woodblock prints. Each episode is a deep dive into a single print, and an exploration of the soul of Old Tokyo. We examine works by artists like Hokusai and Hiroshige not just for their aesthetic and historical value, but for the stories they tell of everyday life. That is how the people of Edo themselves enjoyed this mass-produced medium.

name: The Masterpieces of Ukiyo-e producer Tsutaju
summary: This miniseries presents the masterpieces of Tsutaju, a brilliant ukiyo-e producer of the Edo period.

name: National Parks of Japan
summary: Japan has 34 national parks. Rich in diverse natural attractions, they've been protected by those who call it home and are symbols of Japan's bond with nature.

name: Satoyama Kitchen Diary
summary: Join chef Kogawa Nobuko and her husband Makoto as they take us on a culinary journey through the seasons featuring traditional recipes unique to the mountainous region of Hida Takayama in Gifu Prefecture.

previousepisode.name: All Together to Save the Game!

name: Legacy of the Storm
summary: In the early years of the Ming Dynasty, turmoil swept through the martial world as various sects, driven by greed, waged war against one another in pursuit of the power of the Four Divine Artifacts. Amid this great catastrophe, the chivalrous hero Gao Lingfeng, while uncovering the truth behind a city's destruction and the mystery of his own origins, crosses paths with Sun Chenxi. As paragons of courage and justice, the two join forces to eliminate villains and thwart the sinister schemes of Xuanhuo Sect. Eventually, they succeed in obtaining one of the Four Divine Artifacts, the Azure Dragon's Essence, and Gao Lingfeng finally unravels the secrets behind his past. Together, he and Sun Chenxi take on the solemn duty of seeking the remaining artifacts to safeguard peace across the land...

name: Small Town Setup
summary: An unsuspecting city dwelling single returns home to visit their small town parents, and is met with three potential dates. These suitors have been carefully selected by their parents and community, hopeful they will find love.

name: Anna Haugh's Big Irish Food Tour
summary:
Celebrity chef Anna Haugh is embarking on a culinary journey from Ballycastle in County Antrim to Cork city for Anna Haugh's Big Irish Food Tour.

Anna will be travelling around Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland, exploring the culture and cuisine of her home. In each episode, Anna will be joined by a celebrity guest to meet the people behind some local produce and sample an array of ingredients and flavours the island of Ireland has to offer.

name: DINKs
summary: Josh and Charlie, a couple without marriage or kids, undertake renovating their dilapidated dream home, facing challenges and strengthening their bond as they build a life together through this project.

name: Borgs 24/7
summary: The colourful couple Lisa and Henrik Borg open the door to their life together. Their relationship is the centrepiece, where we see how they support each other through all the trials and triumphs.

name: Gus Plus Us
summary: Get lost in the world of Gus and his simple, lovable charm as he embarks on imaginative adventures with his zany, faithful sidekick, Karrot. Learn about the elementary mysteries of life with their whimsical, friend Lucy as their guide.

name: Queen of Fucking Everything
summary: Middle-aged Linda, accustomed to the good life, is completely betrayed both in love and financially. Driven by shame and unreasonable debts, she sticks her little finger out on the other side of the law and stays there. Linda harnesses her talents to the construction and renovation business and, by stretching her morals, manages to climb to the top.

name: A-laget
summary: There will be revelations, laughter and tears when famous people are challenged by atypical reporters with critical, surprising and unfiltered questions.

name: Draumen om eit småbruk
summary: More and more people dream of a simple life in the countryside, with less stress and more harmony. Ida and Sverre are making that dream come true.

name: Hurri
summary: Who are the koftepoliti, and what is the strangest thing the Sámi Parliament has given money to? A sidelong look at Sámi stereotypes and other minor problems in Sápmi.

name: Стендап рулетка
summary: A new TNT humor project in which comedians will challenge the fortune of humor to catch a cash prize by the tail. Ilya Sobolev, the main "toxic" of the humorous scene, will give participants the opportunity to earn money from jokes, and at the same time test themselves for luck. Each of them goes on stage and jokes for one minute. If the audience thinks that the joke is funny, then a certain amount of money falls into the general pot. After the performance, the comedian stands at the end of the "queue", and the next one comes to the microphone. Whoever remains last will get the opportunity to increase the pot and take everything for themselves.

name: Yo, adicto
summary: A thirty-year-old audiovisual professional, voluntarily checks himself into a rehabilitation center due to his alcohol and cocaine use.

name: Ферма
summary: "The Farm" will tell about a team of novice bloggers who accidentally burn down a clip house. Now they have a new challenge - to survive in the village and repay the debt to serious people...

name: Gachiakuta
summary: In a floating city where the rich discard their waste—and people—Rudo is framed for murder and thrown into the Pit, where a hellscape of mutated garbage beasts dwell. To survive, he must wield a new power and join the rogue Cleaners. Rudo doesn't just aim to battle monsters, but the corrupt who cast him into Hell.

name: Dans de beaux draps
summary: When Justine Blanchet, mother of 16-year-old Capucine and Pierre-Marie, discovers that her husband, Rémi, has been unemployed for six months and that they are on the verge of bankruptcy, her "perfect" world collapses. Unable to cope with this downgrade, Justine will drag Rémi to the dark side of the force to save face. Lacking a plan B, they will implement a plan C. C for burglary. But it's not so easy to improvise as a burglar when you don't have the codes or the network, when the vigilant neighbors are keeping an eye on things, and when the police are zealously investigating... Drawing unexpected fulfillment from this incredible and dangerous double life, the Blanchets will realize the absurdity of their previous life and will gradually find the path to happiness.

name: Gangster Like Me Got a Boyfriend
summary: Yunho, a young man who failed to debut, receives a surprising offer: a three-month dating proposal from Jaeho, a gangster. As Yunho starts to open his heart to Jaeho, who appeared at a critical moment to save him, danger looms as those targeting Jaeho begin to approach him…

name: The Rumour
summary: Joanna moves with her young son, Alfie, to the quiet town of Flinstead, seeking a fresh start. However, she quickly becomes entangled in the lives of local mothers and the unsettling dynamics of the community. When Joanna stumbles upon an online rumour about a child killer living in the town, she uses it to win over the mums at the school gate. As gossip spreads, suspicions build, and Joanna finds herself drawn into a web of secrets and paranoia. Balancing her efforts to protect her son with the growing unease in town, Joanna struggles to distinguish between truth and hearsay. With relationships strained and emotions running high, the boundaries between trust and fear blur.

name: Extreme Makeover: Home Edition
summary: Clea Shearer and Joanna Teplin harness their world-renowned organizational expertise to thoughtfully design and specifically tailor and transform homes from the inside out. Assisting them is a team of builders and contractors from homebuilder Taylor Morrison who expertly reconfigures the homes based on each family's lifestyle and needs.

name: Retreat Yourself
summary:
Retreat Yourself sees unconventional-wellness guru Donna Preston open the retreat's doors to four famous faces, ready to showcase a series of the weird, wonderful, less than conventional coping mechanisms, proving that self care comes in many shapes and forms. 

Singer Jake Quickenden, Love Island favourite Kaz Kamwi, social media star Holly Ramsay and radio DJ Dean McCollough are the celebrities checking into the most extraordinary wellness centre, where host Donna is determined to flip classic wellness activities on their head and prove that when it comes to caring for your mental health, it really is all about just doing ‘whatever gets you through.'

name: Tasokare Hotel
summary: Who is the real you? The "Tasokare Hotel" exists in a state of twilight limbo, allowing souls caught between the afterlife and the world of the living to rest. Neko Tsukahara arrives with no memory of who she is or how she came to be there, and is shown to a room filled with items relating to her past. As she searches for a way to remember who she was, a certain incident confronts her...

name: Maxipes Fík
summary: Like every dog, Fík was a sweet little puppy at first. But he grows so fast and to such a size that he becomes the terror of the neighborhood. Inside, however, he is truly kind and clever. His adventures start at home with his family, then continue at school where he is an exemplary pupil, and afterward out in the wide world. He sails the seas, flies a plane, visits Africa and the Polar Circle and returns home an experienced traveler.

name: Can a Freeloader Make It as a Secretary?
summary: Shirahata Keita breaks up with his girlfriend when she becomes pregnant. After living as a gigolo for many years, he becomes a refugee. Then he finds a job offer with favorable conditions and decides to apply. However, Keita's life changes when he is assigned as secretary to the cold-hearted and heartless president, Kuroda Joji.

name: Vintage
summary: A journey towards maturity and a humorous portrait of toxic masculinities.

name: CNN Saturday Morning Table for Five
summary: Join CNN Saturday Morning for an insightful and provocative discussion of the week's biggest stories.

name: Blauw
summary: The new documentary series Blauw shows what police work really does to officers. In addition to the exciting and challenging aspects of their work, the personal stories and emotions of the officers are central. Who is the person behind the uniform?

name: Couples Council
summary: Studious Megan and entitled Dash are forced to serve as Co-Presidents of the Student Council together, where they'll fight each other on everything, including their growing feelings for one another.

previousepisode.name: My Ex Is Hiding A Secret

name: Love Connection
summary: A single contestant chooses from three potential partners after watching videotaped profiles, then the audience watches their date footage and votes on whether the couple should go on another date.

name: The New Chain Reaction
summary: Chain Reaction, where one word leads to another, and the right word leads to thousands of dollars.

name: Dart Kings
summary:
Dart Kings takes viewers on a nostalgic trip down memory lane through the golden age of darts and shines a spotlight on the nation's most unlikely sporting heroes: Eric Bristow, Jocky Wilson and Phil Taylor.

In 1972, darts staggered out of the pub and onto British primetime television, bringing with it a cast of – by today's standards - unlikely sporting heroes. Today, discipline is key to sporting success but in those first moments when the game hit the bigtime, the greatest players mixed extraordinary skill at the oche with boozing, chain-smoking, and an open-door policy to fans and the media alike.

Yet it was this combination of skill and raw, unfiltered personality that brought in television audiences of over 10 million and created some of the most memorable characters in sporting history.

Against a backdrop of rising unemployment and unrest in 1980s Britain, darts brought entertainment and energy to British audiences. Join us as we explore the incredible journeys of three of the greatest names in darts, charting their rise, rivalries, heartache, and triumphs through the 1970s, ‘80s and '90s.

name: The Lost Women Spies
summary: In 2000, boxes containing top-secret files were found in a garden shed in Cornwall. They detailed the lives and code names of Britain's first female agents sent to the front line during the war. The British spymistress, Vera Atkins, had committed treason by keeping the papers, but she had a reason for doing so. During the war, Prime Minister Churchill desperately needed foreign agents, and though women were not allowed to fight on the front line, they could be sent behind enemy lines as spies. Vera was put in charge of the female spies, and when many of them went missing during the war, never to return, she was determined to find out their fate – in defiance of the British authorities. Vera's files were kept sealed until after she died, but the story of the female spies and the spymistress who led them, which has remained secret for over 50 years, can now be revealed.

name: With Love, Meghan
summary: Meghan, Duchess of Sussex invites friends and famous guests to a beautiful California estate, where she shares cooking, gardening and hosting tips.

previousepisode.name: A High Tide Raises All Boats

name: Al Qadar
summary: Following years of trying to conceive, Tala decides to seek one last, unconventional method to protect her devoted marriage to Zayd and put an end to his family's rebukes, so she hires a surrogate mother.

name: Nile Perch no Joshikai
summary: Career woman, Shimura Eriko, works for a large general trading company on equal footing with the men. She is beautiful and highly educated. Her parents have a house in Tokyo's Setagaya ward. Life seems to be going well for Eriko whose single greatest hang-up is the fact that she does not have any female friends. Her secret pleasure is to read a popular journal written by a housewife influencer of the same age on social media. At one point, she happens to meet Maruo Shoko, the writer of the diary, who lives nearby. Shoko also has no female friends. The two of them who have this point in common, quickly become close. However, some incident causes their relationship to develop in an unexpected direction.

name: Paint The Teacher With My Colors
summary: Depicting the forbidden love triangle between a newlywed couple and one of his students!

name: I Was Favored By The President
summary: Follows an office romance between a nerdy office worker who discovered his ex-boyfriend was actually his boss!

name: Actors High!
summary: A sentai actor and a former child star clash while filming a BL project. To fix things, an assistant producer arranges a retreat, where their guardian spirits—long-lost lovers—reunite. Can this unexpected bond save the project?

name: Chatroom Japan
summary: Chatroom Japan is a platform for NHK WORLD-JAPAN to engage with international residents in Japan. The public broadcaster aims to develop a new relationship with these viewers and, together, explore ways to make their lives better.

name: Spiritual Explorers
summary: Japan - a country of timeless wonder and mystery. The deep spirituality of the Japanese has captured the hearts of many explorers in the past. The journey to uncover the essence of the Japanese spirit, begins.

name: Build for Off Road
summary: If it has wheels and goes off road, Ian Johnson will work on it! He takes you along for the "do it yourself" ride, as we tackle everything from simple bolt-ons to full-on fabrication.

name: Czarne stokrotki
summary: A group of five kindergartners are kidnapped. Meanwhile, geologist Lena and her colleagues prepare for a scientific expedition to Antarctica. When it turns out that the suspect in the kidnapping is Ada, Lena's teenage daughter, the mother postpones her professional plans and returns to her hometown of Wałbrzych to find her daughter, with whom she lost contact many years ago.

name: Florida Heat
summary: Florida Heat takes an unfiltered look at Florida police departments in action.

name: Saol Na Feirme
summary: 6-part documentary series following farmers from all over Ireland over one full farming year. The series brings us into the lives of eleven very different Irish farming families across four seasons of the year. Viewers get to know the men and women who are growing and producing the food we all eat and providing income and employment in our rural communities. The series charts their lives from spring through to winter, how they cope with everything that nature has to throw at them and how they are affected by environmental responsibilities.

name: Tarrac na Farraige
summary: Tarrac na Farraige is a landmark four-part documentary series, and a first for RTÉ, which follows the highs and lows of the Irish fishing community in Ireland over a year. With epic aerial photography, this stunning series goes above and below deck, on land and sea, with fishermen from right around the island as they battle challenging conditions to bring home the catch.

name: The Amazon Review Killer
summary: The shocking story of American serial killer Todd Kohlhepp, who often linked his violent crimes to his reviews on Amazon.

name: Jamie's £1 Wonders & Money-Saving Meals
summary: Jamie Oliver brings us flavour-packed, budget-beating recipes that deliver great value, less waste and mouthwatering meals, from mid-week dinners to making leftovers go further.

name: The Draymond Green Show With Baron Davis: Recap
summary: As always, the two former players bring their unique perspectives on the game, offering commentary not just on the latest NBA news but also on the broader sports culture. Whether it's discussing current trends, sharing personal anecdotes, or breaking down the game's biggest moments, this show is a must-watch for basketball fans who want a closer look at the sport from those who know it best.

name: Nightcap with Shannon Sharpe and Ochocinco: Recap
summary: Expect a lively discussion as Sharpe and Ochocinco dive into the most talked-about plays, controversial calls, and standout performances from this week's games. With their deep knowledge of the game and often humorous banter, the pair will provide viewers with an engaging and entertaining recap that goes beyond just the highlights. Whether you're a die-hard football fan or simply enjoy lively debates, this episode promises to deliver plenty of entertainment and football analysis.

name: Zembilli
summary: The bittersweet and captivating story of the people of a Yörük town in the foothills of the Taurus Mountains.

name: On the Money
summary: On the Money wrapped up the day's news from the worlds of business and everyday life, took a closer look at the money in every story. On the Money literally followed the money through everything from breaking news to politics, to pop culture, and even sports.

name: Levi Strauss und der Stoff der Träume
summary: The focus is on Levi Strauss, who comes to San Francisco in the mid-19th century during the gold rush to try his luck. The son of a Jewish peddler from Upper Franconia was to become one of the greatest pioneers in American history. Together with Jacob Davis, a Jewish tailor from Riga who is almost the same age, he develops the blue jeans that will forever be associated with his name.

name: The Masked Singer: AfterMask
summary: Filmed in studio straight after the main show, the party atmosphere continues on AfterMask, where fans can look forward to chatting and games with the superstar panel of celebrity detectives Mo Gilligan, Davina McCall, Jonathan Ross and newbie Maya Jama, all the tea from host Joel Dommett and exclusive unmasking interviews with the celebrity singers.

name: Reisen mit Muddi
summary: Agnetha Lakshmi Pfeiffer has a whole lot of problems on her hands: Because of her shopping addiction, the bailiff is now after her. She takes the bull by the horns and because she doesn't know where to go, she sets off on a journey that she has been avoiding for the past few weeks: her mother Naina Zareen Pfeiffer has died. She hasn't had a relationship with her mother, a former Bhagwan follower, for many years.

name: Wild Vietnam
summary: Travel from Vietnam's northern mountains to the tropical Mekong Delta in search of the last endemic species threatened by extinction.

name: Eat Smart: Secrets of the Glucose Goddess
summary: Biochemist Jessie Inchauspé shows us how to improve our health by regulating our blood sugar levels. To prove that her methods really work, Jessie helps people who are experiencing extreme symptoms of health conditions that affect us all.

name: Science's Greatest Mysteries
summary: Does science have all the answers? It seems as if the more we discover, the more problems emerge. Exactly how old is our universe? Why are the two sides of our Moon so different? How did iron from space end up next to the body of Tutankhamun? Why do we even exist? This fascinating BBC science documentary series delves into some of the most perplexing problems faced by science and tries to find some solutions.

name: Abandoned Places
summary: Visit the extreme places where the last traces of life are gone but not forgotten.

name: Far From Home
summary:
Throughout the world, aspiring winter athletes struggling with little support from their country put their lives, financial assets, and time on the line in hopes to compete and represent their country on the most significant competition stage in the world: the Winter Olympics. 

This documentary series follows six of the worlds most unlikely Winter Olympic athletes as they strive to break barriers and make history for their respective nations. From the Caribbean to the Himalayas, South America to the Middle East, these athletes share the dream of walking into the Olympic arena with the whole world watching as their country's flag waves above them. This is the story of their inspiration. This is their journey.

previousepisode.name: From skiing on Brazilian streets to racing the world's best in PyeongChang

name: We Love Mallorca
summary: Mallorca is still one of the most popular holiday destinations for Germans. However, more and more people don't just want to spend their holidays there, but dream of settling down as emigrants and living there permanently. Some of them are accompanied in the docu-soap called "We love Mallorca" by the streaming service Joyn.

previousepisode.name: Danke für den Rückhalt - Aaron plant ein Date für Alina

name: Внимание, говорит Москва!
summary: The main character of the film is a nineteen-year-old girl who, despite her young age, has already become a famous sniper. They write about her in newspapers, trumpet on the radio, her courage inspires the soldiers and becomes an example to follow. For everyone, she is a hero, a legend. And who is she in reality - for herself? What is she really experiencing? What secrets does her soul hide?

name: Моя бабушка – призрак
summary:
After her parents divorce, 12-year-old Nastya moves with her mother to the small town of Karachinsk. Having settled in the old house of her deceased grandmother, she transfers to a new school. Relations with classmates do not work out from the first day.

However, the school conflict is not the only problem, because inexplicable things begin to happen at home, which she will have to face every day. In a series of these events, paranormal phenomena and creepy secrets will emerge. The life of the heroes will be shrouded in mysticism and the worst thing is hidden in an abandoned building on the outskirts of the city, which everyone calls a haunted house.

name: Pokoli rokonok
summary:
The new daily series from RTL, Infernal Relatives, is a thrilling story about how rival families in a small town battle for money, power, and love.

Everything is ready for the construction of a battery factory on the outskirts of Pantallós—if István Fejes allows it. The town's mayor, Tihamér Aczél, is determined to make this ambitious Chinese-Hungarian investment happen, a project that would make the entire town wealthy (and especially himself). However, to do so, he must first make peace with István, Pantallós' largest landowner. But István hates Tihamér more than he loves money and declares that the factory will only be built on his ancestral land over his dead body.

This deadlock is disrupted by the arrival of the Guba family, former wealthy bankers. After the collapse of their bank and the arrest of Antal Guba, the family is forced to return to this remote and dull village—Antal's birthplace—where their crumbling house barely stands and where the once-influential Antal Guba is known simply as "Tóni" by the locals.

The intertwined stories of Pantallós' three families explore themes of personal ambition, money, power, and pride. Only by setting aside their differences, settling their debts, overcoming past heartbreaks, and uniting can these characters attain what they truly need: family and love. Because, as the saying goes: "Money fades, but family endures!"

name: My Dearest Nemesis
summary: As a high school senior, Su-Jeong began playing an online game where she met another player nicknamed "Black Dragon". They unexpectedly got close, developing crushes and planning a meeting in real life… that concluded in humiliation and disaster when "Black Dragon" turned out to be an awkward middle schooler instead of the young man he portrayed himself to be! Sixteen years later, Su-Jeong is a skilled planner at Yongseong Department Store, but her job is about to get a shakeup with the arrival of Ban Ju-Yeon, the ambitious new head of strategic planning and heir to the company. There's just one problem: Ban Ju-Yeon is actually "Black Dragon", and Su-Jeong still holds a grudge. Will their past come back to haunt them, or can they find a way to resolve their misunderstandings – and even find love as adults?

name: DMD Friendship The Reality
summary:
DMD Friendship The Reality is a Thai reality competition series featuring a group of Domundi artist trainees who live, train, and compete together through a series of challenges and missions designed to develop their performance skills and interpersonal chemistry. The core goal of the show is to have the participants explore connections with one another, both personally and professionally, as they work to form compatible pairs ("ships") that can become onscreen couples in the future.

Throughout each season, contestants build friendships and potential romantic bonds, are evaluated on various tasks, and interact in ways that test their compatibility on and off camera. The winning couple earns the opportunity to lead roles together in an upcoming Domundi BL series.

name: Accused: The Fake Grooming Scandal
summary: In 2020, 18-year-old Ellie Williams posted on Facebook about being raped by an 'Asian grooming gang' in Barrow. Her post ruptured community relations. But was it true?

name: In The Line of Duty
summary: This drama tells the story of several police officers at a local police station who, in the most complex commercial community, write extraordinary stories in their ordinary positions through the proper handling of various police cases.

name: The Epoch of Miyu
summary: Xu Miyu's perfect marriage shatters on her 10th anniversary, prompting her to rediscover herself and choose divorce. Starting over as a hotel cleaner at Purong Hotel, she crosses paths with Ji Feng, the hotel's new GM and her former acquaintance. As they face workplace challenges together, love blossoms, and they transform Purong Hotel into a rising city landmark.

name: Swap Face
summary: Trainee Constable Su Xiaoqiao swaps identities and appearances with Gu Qingdai, widow of the bandit leader in Qingfeng Village , to investigate her mother's murder. Posing as Gu, Su becomes the bandit stronghold's leader and "marries" Chu Yan who is her undercover

name: Sadistic Love
summary: Helian Zheng deeply loved his stepsister, He Anran, but witnessed her father imprisoning and causing his mother's death. Five years later, Helian Zheng returned as a warlord, capturing his stepfather and forcing marriage with his stepsister to avenge his mother. Mo Yutang, who grew up depending on Helian Zheng, lost the ability to walk properly because of him. Years later, they reunite, but beneath Mo Yutang's stunning stage makeup hides a deep, bone-chilling hatred...

name: Simon Schama's Story of Us
summary: Art and culture define us - but in an age of change, who are we now? In divided times, Simon Schama asks whether art, music and words can be the threads that bind us together.

name: Two of a Kind
summary: Two of a Kind matches one teenager with four strangers to find their secret twin. After taking a personality quiz, the group goes through a series of challenges to determine who's the most compatible. If the teen can guess their secret twin, the group wins big!

name: Stacey & Joe
summary: In this brand new series, cameras follow the lives of Stacey and Joe, their children, four ducks and two dogs. With exclusive behind the scenes access, viewers are given a refreshing, honest take on their modern blended family. Raising their ‘pickles', Zach, Leighton, Rex, Rose and Belle who are aged between 16 and one, is no mean feat especially combined with busy work schedules and ambitious passion projects like building a two acre fishing lake.

previousepisode.name: There's Life in the Old Dog Still

name: Civil War Combat
summary: Civil War Combat is a historical documentary series that takes viewers on a journey through the bloodiest battles of the Civil War.

name: Hur fan hamnade vi här?
summary: The comedian Messiah Hallberg examines various parts of our Swedish society and asks himself the question: how the hell did we end up here?

name: Параллельное вращение
summary: "Parallel Rotation" is a two-part film about figure skater Alena Kostornaya, who started her career from scratch after winning gold at the European Championships. Everyone expected her to win an Olympic medal, but a series of injuries and controversial decisions almost led to her leaving the sport. Alena did not give up and went into pair skating, where her previous achievements mean nothing.

name: Screaming
summary: Carla Lane's comedy about one man's devastating effect upon three intelligent women.

name: Lee Söker Kärleken
summary: Lee Christiernsson hasn't dated since Facebook was launched 18 years ago. Now, with the 50th anniversary around the corner, Lee dares to bet on love again and posted a personal ad on social media. For the one who once became popular as "Snickar-Björn", it was the start of an emotional journey. How will Lee fare in his pursuit of love? A series about facing new relationships and oneself in a completely new chapter in life.

name: Lerin på äldreboendet
summary: Can lost memories be evoked through paintings? Lars Lerin meets eight elderly people with various dementias and other illnesses. Together with their relatives, they meet to paint, create and go on excursions. At the same time, Lars is busy with his artistry, his own aging and life as a young father of four children together with his husband Junior.

name: Cecilias Unge
summary: Comedian Jonatan Unge is going on a stand-up tour in Europe. With him he has his mainstay in life: mother Cecilia Hagen. It will be a chaotic journey with missed trains, improvised stand ups and unexpected tourist destinations. Maybe the trip is really just an excuse for the big joint mission: to teach Unge to become independent before it's too late.

name: Rättegången
summary: Jens Lapidus follows the game in the courtroom in six known cases. It will be a journey filled with gripping stories and surprising turning points where Lapidus, with his long experience as a lawyer, penetrates behind the headlines of the evening papers and guides us into the world of various criminal cases. What issues will decide the case and why does the court rule as it does?

name: Today with Jenna & Friends
summary: America's feel-good morning show with big stars and sweet surprises; a cast of rotating co-hosts join Jenna Bush Hager for an hour of heartfelt connection, inspirational stories, fun and laughs.

name: The Lost Boys
summary: Three part dramatisation about five brothers befriended by playwright J. M. Barrie in Kensington Gardens and later adopted by him after their parent's death.

name: Il camorrista
summary: The Camorra boss known as "The Professor" manages and administers the reformed Camorra from prison. Helped by his faithful sister Rosaria, the man escapes from the penitentiary and creates a powerful criminal organization that manages to infiltrate all levels of society. The never seen before, only TV series ever made by Oscar winner Giuseppe Tornatore. Restored in 4k with the official soundtrack by Oscar winner Nicola Piovani.

name: Bie Dong Wo De Nan Zhujiao
Wzgórze psów
summary: A successful and renowned novelist — haunted by trauma and a mysterious blackmailer — returns to his hometown to reckon with his unresolved past.

name: Grand Designs Sverige - Återbesöken
summary: Grand Designs Sverige - Återbesöken brings Mark Isitt back to some of the most memorable and spectacular houses in Grand Design's history.

name: Bianca by Night
summary: Bianca Ingrosso takes the stage at Berns in Stockholm. She invites us and the audience to meet celebrities and enjoy surprises and live music.

name: Poulets grillés
summary: Commander Anne Capestan leads a brigade of the judicial police of Lyon to which only alcoholic, depressed and maladjusted police officers are assigned. Despite this, she managed to successfully process the most important investigation of the moment.

name: Fox News Live
summary: The show featured news, guest analysis, and interviews. Like other American cable news stations, there is news mixed with feature-like stories, as well as commentary and short debates between people on opposite sides of issues, usually between associates of candidates and officials, think-tank members, and journalists.

name: Weekend Live
summary:
Weekend Live was an American news/talk television program on Fox News Channel.

The program featured live news story updates from correspondents, analysis from a number of different regular contributors, interviews with newsmakers of the week, and regular subject specific segments. Compared to other programming on the network, it didn't feature a commentary segment, but does have regular one-minute "Fox Real Time" news recaps.

name: Rainkissed Fate
summary: The wealthy heiress Bu Yan is set up and spends a passionate night with boxer He Yuchen, only to disappear afterward. Six years later, she returns with a pair of twins and crosses paths with He Yuchen, who has fallen into despair after a match-fixing scandal. Needing cord blood for her son, Bu Yan decides to use He Yuchen, leading them to enter a contract marriage that turns into real love. They then uncover the dark truths of their past together.

name: Vinnie Politan Investigates
summary: Every story, every trial, every case has at least two sides. In this weekday series, Court TV's Vinnie Politan looks at every angle of the cases making headlines. Dive into the latest true crime stories inside and outside of the courtroom in Vinnie Politan Investigates. Starting Monday, you can watch VPI every weeknight at 9/8c on Court TV and CourtTV.com.

previousepisode.name: New Arrest in Gilgo Beach Murders

name: Subteran
summary: A young mother's life is upended when she finds herself hiding behind a secret identity to escape the Bucharest gang responsible for her fiancé's death.

name: Devil in the Family: The Fall of Ruby Franke
summary: When popular vlogger Ruby Franke is arrested for child abuse in August 2023, it quickly becomes one of the biggest trending stories in America. For years, the Frankes' YouTube channel had documented a wholesome, happy family life, with 2.5 million subscribers tuning in at its peak. But happy families are rarely what they seem. As the cracks began to show, the family turned to counselor Jodi Hildebrandt for guidance – and rapidly found themselves trapped in a nightmare. Only the Frankes know what went on inside their home. This series marks the first time Shari and Chad, the Frankes' two eldest adult children, and Kevin, Ruby's husband, will share their story in depth on camera. With exclusive access to the Frankes, their friends and neighbors, and over a thousand hours of their YouTube channel's unseen footage, Devil in the Family: The Fall of Ruby Franke cuts through the social media reaction to explore the untold story behind the Ruby Franke case: part family tragedy, part coming-of-age narrative, part tale of our times about the perils of life lived online.

name: The Chef's Garden
summary:
The Chef's Garden joins Farmer Lee Jones on his farm as he meets with renowned chefs from across the country to celebrate fresh produce and regenerative agriculture with aspirational, creative dishes.

In each half hour episode, The Chef's Garden brings viewers to the farm and into its industrial kitchen, the Culinary Vegetable Institute, where Farmer Lee and his chef friends—some of the most celebrated names in the industry including Emma Bengtsson, Curtis Duffy, Jenner Tomaska, and Rachael Ray — use the inspiration from the farm to experiment and cook together. Utilizing the ingredients around them, the chefs create dishes ranging from beat granita with cured salmon and chilled corn soup to Thai spiced shepherd's pie and crab meat stuffed burrata with roasted watermelon and tomatoes.

previousepisode.name: Tomatoes and Watermelon with Jenner Tomaska

name: Carl Weber's The Family Business: New Orleans
summary: Welcome to a new branch of the Duncan family tree, known for their popular casino / nightclub ‘Midnight Blues' where tourists, titans of industry, and trap kings & queens party side-by-side. But the club also holds secrets so dark that it could turn the vibrant city of New Orleans upside down. Facing threats at every turn, the Duncans try to keep their family safe and put their complicated pasts to the side for the greater good of their enduring legacy in the NOLA.

name: Kalla Fakta Lokala Skandaler
summary: Lokala Skandaler is a series in which Kalla fakta examines revelations that shook Swedish towns. The episodes are based on news events that upset and arouse emotions. With the help of local reporters and residents, Emil Hellerud and Carolina Jemsby dig further into the cases in search of more answers. We meet heroes, designated villains and local residents who are affected by the decisions in the corridors of power.

name: Tokyo Salad Bowl
summary: Koda Mari is a green-haired police officer in the International Investigation Unit of the Higashi-Shinjuku Police Department. Energetic and cheerful, she's dedicated to helping anyone in need, regardless of nationality. Arikino Ryo is a Chinese interpreter at the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department's Interpretation Center. He has committed himself to providing precise translations between officers, witnesses, and suspects. However, he decides to leave the police force after a painful incident. When Mari and Ryo cross paths, they join forces to solve all sorts of multinational cases. As they interact with foreign residents and share meals from around the world, Mari and Ryo's journey sheds light on the challenges and experiences of living in a foreign land.

name: Red Carpet - Vip al tappeto
summary: Herbert Ballerina, Brenda Lodigiani, Antonio Ornano, Awed, Ginevra Fenyes, Pierluca Mariti, Michela Giraud, Gabriele Vagnato, and Francesco Arienzo are the bodyguards in the first edition of "Red Carpet Survival." The best team, at the end of the four episodes, will win the coveted Golden Pigeon. Alessia Marcuzzi will lead the bodyguards. Commenting on it all are the voices of Gialappa's Band.

name: Ekiben Japan
summary: "Ekiben" are lunch boxes sold at train stations enjoyed during train journeys which are filled with the charm of each region of Japan! Let's embark on a journey to encounter a selection of lunch boxes from all over Japan!

previousepisode.name: Homegrown Flavors Shaped by Harsh Nature

name: Lex Fridman
summary: Conversations about the nature of intelligence, consciousness, love, and power.

previousepisode.name: #501 – DHH: Future of Programming, AI, Agentic Engineering, Vibe Coding & Linux

name: I'll Turn Back This Time
summary: Shen Nan and Gu Shi Wen become family after each other's parents remarry. They fall in love with each other, and the gentle Shen Nan helps heal Gu Shi Wen's heart. However, their love gets hindered, and Shen Nan tries everything to turn back time, prevent tragedy and fight against destiny...

name: Makeup With Mud
summary: Yuzuhara Miku is a temporary employee who works for a reception desk at a department store. She has low self confidence and worries about what others think of her, but is clueless when it comes to makeup. Her elite lawyer boyfriend Haruhisa however, constantly tells her she he prefers seeing her that way, so she wore minimal makeup because he favors her "modest" look. One day, she meets Takakura Eve, a guy with a special love for makeup. When he applied red lipstick on her, Miku felt a sense of exhilaration. However, when Haruhisa found out about this, he transforms into an emotionally abusive man.

name: Ghost of Tsushima
summary: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends is getting an anime adaptation, bringing epic battles and untold samurai stories to life in 2027. Premiering exclusively on Crunchyroll

name: The Weekend View
summary: The Weekend View will focus on the biggest stories in entertainment and the buzziest news topping social media feeds. With all-new "Hot Topics," the co-hosts will give their one-of-a-kind takes with their signature candor and humor. Plus, "The Weekend View" will include "Behind the Table" segments with executive producer Brian Teta and the co-hosts as they dive deeper into pop-culture stories from the week.

name: W.A.G.s to Riches
summary: They're the wives and girlfriends of famous athletes and rap stars, but these stylishly smart W.A.G.s call the shots in this soapy reality series.

name: Flower and Asura
summary: After the president of the school's broadcasting club invites Kana to join the club due to her unparalleled narrating talents, Kana embarks on a journey to discover her love of reading — and maybe even change the course of her life along the way.

name: The Curious Case Of…
summary: The Curious Case Of… will dive into some of the most shocking true crime cases and unbelievable scandals. From a con man with multiple identities whose crimes stretch across the globe to a religious doomsday cult centered around worshipping cats, each episode will go inside these real-life cases exposing bizarre secrets, shattered lives, and twisted motives. Led by Karas, with her extensive legal expertise and insight, each gripping story will uncover deceit, greed, and manipulation and offer key access to shocking, first-hand accounts - proving the truth is much more chilling than fiction.

previousepisode.name: The Curious Case Of... The Corpse Who Came to Dinner

name: Trolösa
summary: A triangle drama between married couple Markus and Marianne and their best friend David, where desire, jealousy and betrayal destroy both friendship and love relationships. But above all, it is Markus and Marianne's daughter Isabelle who has been hit hard. Based on a story by Ingmar Bergman.

name: Yoo Tee Rao
summary: Kan, a hot-headed college freshman who is bad at socializing, is invited by his senior Ton to go on a motorcycle getaway trip with friends. Kan invites his girlfriend, Toey, a third-year engineering student to go with him to get to know his friends. The trip seems fun until Kan's hot-headed nature brings about unexpected events.

name: En haute mer
summary: Aurélie, an inspector who clumsily let a young man suspected of being involved in the disappearance of his girlfriend go, learns that he was arrested on a Swiss merchant navy cargo ship for the murder of a sailor. Sent to South Africa to repatriate him, she discovers that the missing girl was a passenger on this cargo ship a few weeks earlier. She continues her investigation alone, facing resistance from the crew.

name: Born to Die
summary: Song Dianxin, feamale general of Haiyin Kingdom, was accused of treason and died. Before this, she learned that she was betrayed by her fiancé, Shen Musi. Luckily, Song Dianxin is reborn and then immediately breaks off the engagement. She fights against the despicable man and avenges her friends who hurted her. However, it turns out that Shen Musi was also a victim of treachery. After his own rebirth, he pursues his love while investigating the truth. This leads to an intense love-hate relationship with Song Dianxin, full of cat-and-mouse dynamics.

name: Гипнозис
summary: The story of three friends: a private detective with the ability to read minds, a lawyer with the gift of seeing a person's future, and a priest with the gift of seeing the past. All of them, thanks to their abilities, have settled down quite well in life. But at some point, someone appears on the horizon who wants to take revenge on them for what they did in the distant past.

name: A Better Place
summary: "A world without prisons" - that is the revolutionary goal of Trust, a rehabilitation program in North Rhine-Westphalia. The program manager Petra Schach promises released prisoners work, housing, therapy and a life of freedom! A Better Place tells the story of a city without prisons from multiple perspectives. Dystopia or the turning point towards a better world?!?

previousepisode.name: Wir dürfen die Hoffnung nicht verlieren

name: El Mejor Infarto de mi Vida
summary: Based on the eponymous book by Argentine author Hernán Casciari and inspired by real events, "The Best Heart Attack of My Life" follows a frustrated writer who survives a heart attack thanks to the help of his hosts at the temporary rental house where he is staying. It's an event that will change his life, and that of those around him, forever.

name: Health Uncensored with Dr. Drew
summary: Health Uncensored with Dr. Drew. is an innovative, informative and entertaining new National Television Series. Dr. Drew Pinsky introduces us to the most important ideas in the new era of health and medicine. From the latest medical breakthroughs to simple home health solutions, Dr. Drew discusses it all with leading experts. Health Uncensored with Dr. Drew topics are timely and compelling, including brain health, emotional resilience, vitality and aging, super foods for cancer prevention, and the "magic pill" of exercise. The program also informs us about the role each of us play in creating a healthier life and world. Dr. Drew brings his insight and knowledge to each episode as he presents a truly global picture of health practices, both new and time-tested.

previousepisode.name: The Future of Recovery and Care with Dr. Drew

name: Monty Don's British Gardens
summary: The nation's outdoor home. From the humble backyard to the grandest of grounds, what do Britain's gardens tell us about our culture, climate and history?

name: The Water Magician
summary: Ryo is delighted to be reincarnated into the fantastical world of Phi, where he thinks he'll get to live a quiet life learning to use his newfound water magic. Going with the flow here, however, means something very different. Ryo is immediately pitted against the wild lands he winds up in and the slew of deadly monsters that call the remote subcontinent home. You'd think he'd forget about taking it easy when he's stuck fighting for his life, but lucky for Ryo, he's naturally optimistic, clever, and blessed with the hidden "Eternal Youth" trait. Twenty years pass in the blink of an eye, and each encounter along the way pushes him one step closer to the pinnacle of human magic. Little does he realize that's only the opening chapter of his tale. A fateful meeting soon thrusts Ryo to the forefront of history, forever changing the course of his life... Thus begins the adventures of the strongest water magician the world has ever seen—who also likes to do things at his own pace!

name: De Oranjewinter
summary: Hélène Hendriks kicks off the year with 'De Oranjewinter'. In this winter version of her successful talk show 'De Oranjezomer' she receives changing guests with whom she discusses the latest news.

name: La rebelle - Les aventures de la jeune George Sand
summary: Young Aurore Dupin seeks to escape the violence of her husband Baron Dudevant, who is ready to do anything to keep her under his control. Her two children and her passion for writing are her only reasons for living. However, her meeting with Jules Sandeau, who shares her love of writing, gives her hope of one day becoming a free woman. While her husband hatches a plan to prevent her from leaving the Nohant estate, Aurore persuades her young lover to follow her to Paris where they can finally live out their passion in complete freedom...

name: Gerry Star
summary: Gerry Star is a hit producer, heartthrob and businessman - at least that's what he thinks. But in reality, he lives in a bowling alley and only dreams of a big breakthrough with his band ‘Family Strike'. In reality, however, the road to fame is full of obstacles, because everything Gerry Star touches backfires...

name: Joling & Gordon over de vloer
summary: Gerard Joling and Gordon stay and work three days with a family, club or company. These are places that are totally different from their everyday lives. The two "divas" do not know in advance where they are going. Frequently they fail to perform tasks assigned. The program is based on the format that formed the basis for the series The Simple Life with Paris Hilton and Nicole Richie, that looks like the comedy TV series Green Acres.

name: Algorytm miłości
summary:
Participants in the series parody Algorytm miłości put their fate in the hands of artificial intelligence to find a perfectly matched love and win the program. Find out how much you can do for reach, fame and money!

The new series from the creators of The Office PL is not only a sharp parody of reality, but of the entire entertainment and mass entertainment. Because although sometimes it is embarrassing to admit it, we all love it.

name: Breaking Beyond
summary: In the six-part series Breaking Beyond, six breakers discover the dance, breaking and hip hop culture in different cities around the world. In every episode, we follow each breaker as a host in a big metropole in their home countries, and learn about their lives and background stories. Every B-Boy and B-Girl's story is unique, and the contrasts between them show us how diverse the global breaking culture is. In the destination cities, the breakers are divided into hosts and guests, where one will take on the other and show them their culture, lifestyle and country. They will take a deep dive into the city's hip hop culture with a strong focus on break dancing.

name: HELLO HELLO HELLO
summary: Join Onya Nurve as she says "Hello! Hello! Hello!" to the queens of RuPaul's Drag Race Season 18! Get an in-depth look at the queen's audition tapes and find out what the cast really thinks about each other when the library is opened.

name: Harald og Sonja
summary: For nine years, the Norwegian Crown Prince Harald and commoner Sonja Haraldsen fight for their right to marry, but the decision lies with King Olav. The Norwegian constitution bars Harald from marrying without royal consent, risking the monarchy's collapse. Defying tradition, the couple stands against the royal court, government, and press—all for love.

name: Blindspår
summary: During a deadly snowstorm, a train from Stockholm to Narvik collides with an avalanche, and the passengers are forced to take shelter in an isolated hotel. Among them is the sharp but suspended murder investigator Hanne Wilhelmsen). At the hotel, two mysterious murders take place. Together with the Norwegian doctor Magnus, Hanne tries to find out what has happened.

name: The Fuse
summary: Austin Healey presents The Fuse - an explosive daytime quiz show on ITV1.

name: Rekviem for Selina
summary: Rekviem for Selina is about 17-year-old Selina, who, in an attempt to get revenge on her bullies, gets into trouble to change the world. Selina goes from being an outsider who writes a diary on the internet, to becoming the country's most dangerous role model with more readers than the country's largest newspapers.

name: The City Uncovered with Evan Davis
summary: A series of three documentaries lifting the lid on the crisis in global finance.

name: Team Pølsa
summary: Six young people with various disabilities have a big goal this winter. Will they be able to complete a ski race on the demanding trails used during the World Ski Championships in Trondheim?

name: Katastrofe
summary: How well prepared are we for the next disaster? Andreas Wahl puts Norway to the test through six fictional but realistic disaster scenarios.

name: Barnesykehuset
summary: What happens when doctors discover a huge brain tumor in a five-year-old child? What do plastic surgeons do when they discover that a two-year-old girl's foot is infested with flesh-eating bacteria?

name: Bakemesterskapet junior
summary: For the very first time, a Norwegian junior baking champion will also be crowned! Eight talented kids between the ages of 10 and 13 will take over the baking tent to compete until the flour flies, the laughter bubbles and the tears flow. In the junior Baking Championship, they give it their all to impress the judges with the most beautiful pastries. Along the way, they also become friends and each other's best helpers.

name: The Planners Are Coming
summary: A series looking at building planning processes.

name: Adsız Aşıklar
summary: Cem, scarred by a childhood that crushed his trust in love, is the invisible hero of Love Hospital, a place he established to cure those suffering from the "love disease." All of Cem's success and dreams now depend on Hazal, an unexpected presence in his life who, in stark contrast to him, believes that love will save the world.

name: The Fall of Diddy
summary: From Maxine Productions (the producers behind Quiet on Set: The Dark Side of Kids TV) and Rolling Stone Films, the docuseries features exclusive, never-before-heard accounts and never-before-seen archival footage, offering personal insights into harrowing allegations of violent behavior and illegal activity that have shadowed the music mogul. Spanning Combs' decades-long impact on music and popular culture, from his early days as a talented creative to his 2024 arrest, the docuseries uncovers the insidious and terrifying allegations of sexual assault, abusive behavior, violence, and other disturbing claims that lay beneath his success.

name: Ekspedisjonen
summary: Six famous Norwegians are going to climb the world's coldest mountain, Denali in Alaska. Now they have to bring everything they have – because this will be both tough and dangerous.

name: The Last Millionaire
summary: Britain's most successful young entrepreneurs compete to see who can create the most profitable businesses in six cities across the world.

name: Don't Look Back in Anger
summary: A selection of archive news stories, looking back at the headlines of the past 20 years, accompanied by a soundtrack of music of the time.

name: Денди — Новая реальность
summary: TV show about video games for game consoles Dendy (Famicom clone), Sega, Game Boy and Super Nintendo.

name: Я это уже видел
summary: Animated almanac, which is a sketch and plots drawn by various artists and animators from all over Russia.

name: Кинопоиск: Любимые франшизы
summary: A story about cult works and their sequels, without which it is difficult to imagine the landscape of modern cinema.

name: Кинопоиск: Как устроен спорт
summary: About how sport goes beyond arenas, points and seconds and influences the world around it. Each episode is dedicated to a separate sporting event or an important tournament.

name: Love Like A Bike
summary: In Pattaya, three adopted brothers run a bicycle café together. The gentle and composed eldest, Nub-Nueng, is a psychologist. The second brother, Tawan, is a former pilot haunted by the trauma of a plane crash. The youngest, Sky, is a top nightclub host. Each faces a different challenge in love: Nub-Nueng meets Sailom, who suffers from androphobia; Tawan reunites with Dindin, a one-night stand from his past; and Sky finds himself evenly matched with sharp-witted business elite Nava. Through a transformative cycling journey, the three brothers ride toward their own destinations of happiness.

name: Кинопоиск: Каким мы запомним 2023 год
summary: A documentary series from Kinopoisk with an analysis of the most important things that came out in 2023: Barbie, Oppenheimer, Killers of the Flower Moon, The Last of Us. First published on Kinopoisk's YouTube channel.

name: Круг
summary:
Welcome to the CIRCLE. Eight people gather around the table to play eight games. But they don't even know that it's them who will get played. The winner will receive 1,000,000 rubles. 

Anton Shastun, Dima Pozov, Sergey Matvienko and Arseniy Popov each selected two participants to advance to the final.

name: Calipari: Razor's Edge
summary: John Calipari always finds a way to win, and Arkansas is counting on just that. But in the chaotic world of college hoops, it's never been harder to build a winner. There's no time to waste, as Calipari tries to mold young men into champions.

name: Pitino: Red Storm Rising
summary: The St. John's Red Storm are on a mission to end a 25-year drought without an NCAA Tournament win. Their head coach, Rick Pitino, has much bigger goals. Entering his 50th year of coaching, Pitino is looking to make one more run in a legendary career.

name: Wild Mexico
summary: Mexico is a land of lush tropical jungles, orange sunburnt deserts, vast green pine forests, white snow-capped volcanoes and deep blue lakes, and each of these amazing landscapes is inhabited by a surprising range of wildlife and human cultures.

previousepisode.name: Een discussie over een parkeerprobleem laait hoog op

name: Murder UK
summary: Criminologist David Wilson investigate UK murder cases, revealing motives, patterns, and the psychology of killers.

name: The Eunuch Maker
summary: Marcel Theroux explores the dark and disturbing world of The Eunuch Maker.

name: Manhunt
summary: Cameras follow a specialist police unit dealing with urgent manhunts.

name: Die Schlangenfängerin - Gefahr Down Under
summary:
Julia's job is both passion and danger: she is a professional snake catcher in Brisbane, Australia. A place with one of the highest snake populations in the world.

Many of the species that live there are dangerous, poisonous and some of them are even deadly. No place is safe anymore, the snakes are everywhere. Julia finds the dangerous animals in kindergartens, bedrooms, toilets and air conditioning systems. And the snake season has just begun.

The Australian's everyday life is full of action, excitement and driven by her customers who find themselves in tricky situations. As a professional snake catcher, only she is able to master this dangerous job. Julia's goal is to ensure that no one gets hurt or even bitten by one of the deadliest snakes in the world: the Eastern brown snake. Because there are plenty of them in Julia's area of operation.

name: Король и Шут: Экстра
summary: The series' creators let viewers into their creative process: they tell how they brought the punk band's story to the screen, discuss its contribution to music, and even compete in their knowledge of KiSh's work.

previousepisode.name: Актёры смотрят сцены из «Король и Шут. Навсегда»

name: The Musical Murder
summary: Dao Panprakai, a famous and perfect theatre actress, unexpectedly finds herself attending her own funeral. After discovering her boyfriend's affair with another man, she fakes a suicide to gain attention, only to accidentally die for real. Her friend Khunphol, an acting coach, doubts her death was intentional, leading Dao to try to communicate with him and uncover the truth behind her demise.
